description: This file contains a shell script that sets up multiple git repositories and tests pushing to a group of remotes, specifically testing the push behavior across multiple repositories.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes multiple git repositories, configures remote push URLs, and sets up the testing environment.

methods.name: push to group
methods.description: Performs push operation to a group remote and verifies that all repositories have matching refs after push.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
